accepted_gaps.statement: No unified cross-species framework currently links conserved communication-signal representations to human speech-specific auditory-motor control.
The developmental mechanism that transforms relatively bilateral early language organization into common adult leftward specialization remains unresolved.
The causal contribution of multiscale auditory-motor timing to learned speech control is not established by oscillatory tracking alone.
The relative contributions of conserved circuit structure, human-specific connectivity, genes, anatomy, and prolonged learning are not quantitatively separated.
Reported evolutionary dates for speech-like capacity are not commensurable unless the phenotype level is explicitly defined.
